blocks.text: South Korean singer-actress IU is returning to the Philippines for a two-day concert in January 2027 as part of her upcoming world tour. IU announced the concert dates through her official social media accounts, including Facebook, on Sunday, Nov. 22, unveiling the first leg of her 2027 world tour. The singer, whose real name is Lee Ji-eun, is scheduled to perform at the Philippine Sports Stadium in Bulacan on January 30 and 31, 2027.
